hypothesis: Add Conversion Signal Audit (Phase 3.5) — pre-build conversion validation gate between design approval and code generation
benchmark_task: Apply design-first principles to validate the Authority Flywheel landing page design before building
what_changed: Added Phase 3.5 between Copy-Fit Integration and MCP Build. 5 validation steps: Eye-Flow Trace (entry point, flow direction, exit risk per fold), Decision Friction Inventory (cognitive load, commitment clarity, risk signal proximity to CTAs), Skepticism-Proof Placement Audit (proof at skepticism peaks not clustered), 3-Second Fold Test (what/why/do per fold), Conversion Signal Scorecard (6 binary pass/fail signals). All 6 must pass before build. Design-phase fix, not code-phase fix.
why_it_works: Baseline workflow validated aesthetic fidelity (does the code match the design?) but never validated conversion fidelity (will the design convert?). Beautiful non-converting designs are the most expensive failure because they feel complete. The audit catches CTA ambiguity, proof misplacement, cognitive dead zones, and decision friction before a single line of code is written. Fixes are design changes, not code patches.
